schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to take older relatives or people with walking difficulties out?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في اصطحاب كبار السن من أقاربك أو من يجدون صعوبة في المشي إلى الخارج؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, mit älteren Angehörigen oder Menschen mit Gehschwierigkeiten unterwegs zu sein?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to take older relatives or people with walking difficulties out?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که سالمندان خانواده یا افراد دارای مشکل راه رفتن را بیرون ببرید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de emmener des proches âgés ou des personnes qui ont du mal à marcher en sortie ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy idős hozzátartozókat vagy nehezen járó embereket elvinni valahová?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a portare fuori familiari anziani o persone con difficoltà a camminare?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, yaşlı akrabalarınızı veya yürüme güçlüğü olan kişileri dışarı çıkarmaktan vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
